contexts.goal: Follow these steps to perform this Touch Lag Troubleshooting
contexts.title: Touch lag recovery

actions.description: It will improve touch responsiveness

steps: If you wish to keep your screen protector on, turn on Touch sensitivity.
Navigate to and open Settings.
Tap Display.
Tap the switch next to Touch sensitivity.

actionableDeeplink.description: Enables touch sensitivity via device Settings on the device.

steps: If the Touch sensitivity setting is enabled when you are not using a protective film, turn off Touch sensitivity.
Navigate to and open Settings.
Tap Display.
Tap the switch next to Touch sensitivity to disable it.

actionableDeeplink.description: Disables touch sensitivity via device Settings on the device.

actions.description: It will stop gestures blocking your taps

steps: Navigate to and open Settings.
Tap Display.
Tap Navigation bar.
Select Buttons to turn off full screen gestures.

actionableDeeplink.description: Opens the navigation bar settings page in device Settings on the device.

actions.description: It will keep your personal data safe

steps: Back up your personal data to avoid losing it.

actionableDeeplink.description: Enables data backup to TechCorp Cloud via device Settings on the device.

actions.description: It will remove buggy apps

steps: Check for updates for any third-party apps you use, as these can sometimes affect gesture customization.

actions.description: It will remove interference from the screen

steps: If your screen protector is peeling or has debris under it, remove it.
Wipe the front and back with a lint-free, soft microfiber cloth or a camera lens cleaning cloth.
Avoid applying too much pressure when cleaning.

actions.description: It will rule out a faulty charger

steps: Use a different, undamaged charger.

actions.description: It will refresh the system

steps: For devices with a Power button, press and hold the Power button.
Tap Restart.
Tap Restart again to confirm.
For devices with a Side button, swipe down from the top of the screen with two fingers to open the Quick settings panel.
Tap the Power icon.
If the touchscreen is completely unresponsive, force a restart by pressing and holding the Volume down button and the Power button (or Side button) simultaneously for about 10 seconds.
Press the Power button or Side button again to turn it back on.

actions.description: It will isolate third-party apps

steps: Press and hold the Power button (or Side button) and the Volume down button at the same time.
Swipe down from the top of the screen with two fingers and tap the Power icon.
Touch and hold Power off.
Tap Safe mode.
Remove any third-party apps that were recently updated or installed around the time the issue began.
Restart your phone or tablet, and it will boot up normally.

actions.description: It will restore original factory settings

steps: Navigate to and open Settings.
Tap General management.
Tap Reset.
Tap Factory data reset.
Swipe to and tap Reset.
Tap Delete all.
Enter your TechCorp account credentials to complete the reset.

actionableDeeplink.description: Opens the Factory data reset settings screen
actionableDeeplink.message: Open Factory data reset in device Settings

contexts.goal: Follow these steps to perform this Black Screen Troubleshooting
contexts.title: Black screen recovery

actions.description: It will help identify any visible damage

steps: Inspect your phone or tablet, charger, and USB cable for any physical damage or signs of liquid exposure.
Remove any cases or accessories that might be covering the charging port or buttons.
Examine the USB connections for any corrosion or bent pins.
Check the Liquid Damage Indicator (LDI).
Turn off your phone or tablet.
Insert the ejector tool into the small hole next to the SIM/MicroSD tray to eject the tray.
Shine a flashlight into the SIM/MicroSD slot.

actions.description: It will provide power to the phone

steps: Connect your phone or tablet to its appropriate charger and let it charge for at least 1 hour.

actions.description: It will attempt to turn on phone

steps: Disconnect the phone or tablet from the charger.
Try to turn it on by pressing and holding the Power button (or Side button) for 15 to 20 seconds.
Turn off your device and reconnect it to the appropriate charger until it is fully charged.

actions.description: It will get professional help

steps: Contact the Customer Support Center for further assistance.

actions.description: It will reboot the device

steps: If there's no physical or liquid damage, force a restart on your device.
Press and hold both the Power button (or Side button) and the Volume down button simultaneously for at least 20 seconds.
If your device has a removable battery, remove the battery for 60 seconds.
Reinsert it.
